4. SMS Messaging Terms

4.1 SMS Program Description

VVD Ventures LLC DBA Howard's Draperies operates an SMS messaging program to communicate with customers who have explicitly opted in through our website contact forms. We send two types of SMS messages:

  • Transactional SMS: appointment confirmations and reminders, consultation scheduling updates, order status notifications, installation scheduling, and service follow-ups. These messages are sent to help you manage your window treatment project.
  • Marketing & Promotional SMS: special offers, Hunter Douglas rebate announcements, seasonal promotions, and review requests following completed installations.

SMS messages are sent by VVD Ventures LLC DBA Howard's Draperies, located at 4450 Arapahoe Ave, Suite 100, Boulder, CO 80303. Message frequency may vary depending on your project status and opt-in selections.

You may also opt out by contacting us directly using the information in Section 12 below.
